paras: Liolaemus ortizii, also known commonly as Ortiz's tree iguana, is a species of lizard in the family Liolaemidae.  The species is endemic to Peru.
The specific name, ortizii, is in honor of Chilean herpetologist Juan Carlos Ortíz-Zapata.
Liolaemus ortizii is found in the Department of Cusco, Peru.
The preferred natural habitat of Liolaemus ortizii is grassland, at elevations of 4,119–4,250 m (13,514–13,944 ft).
